exercitātiō, exercitātiōnis f.

noun, third declension

Other words

  • sē exercēre — exercise, work out

    classical · Traupman 45, 83; M-O s.v. exercise; Cic.; Traupman 60; Traupman 61; Traupman 63; Traupman 311

  • exercitō, exercitāre, exercitāvī, exercitātum — train, exercise hard

    verb, first conjugation; sē exercitāre, to train · also used · classical · Mela 2.1.5: Achillēs ibi sē ac suōs cursū exercitāvisse memorātur (Lewis & Short); Traupman 66

    Frequentative of exerceō; Lewis & Short: rare in the finite verb, common as the participle exercitātus, trained.

See also gym, jog, skip.
